methods.method-0000: Encode the chosen request line and headers with CRLF, calculate any content length and append the exact body bytes.
methods.method-0001: Apply startup, method, header cardinality, token state, caller limits, path syntax and resource checks in that order.
methods.method-0002: Apply startup before the method check and require a single ticket header only after GET dispatch passes.
methods.method-0003: Apply common dispatch before the client-address limit and serve the chosen bounded discovery document only after both pass.
methods.method-0004: Apply method and coding before any body limit or profile; failed prefixes and failed profiles leave the supplied state unchanged.
methods.method-0005: Apply the address limit after method/coding and before reading the body, then scan the body and check device_name first.
